instruction: Change the formula in cell D1 of Calc so that the price from C1 is formatted to two decimal places using the TEXT function and format code '0.00' in the sentence.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying the formula in D1 to use TEXT(C1,"0.00") to format the number 19.5 with 2 decimal places. Getter extracts both the formula (with data_only=False) and calculated value (with data_only=True) from cell D1. Metric verifies: (1) D1 contains a formula starting with '=', (2) formula uses TEXT function, (3) formula references C1, (4) formula uses format code "0.00", and (5) calculated value equals 'The price is 19.50 euros.'
